parts: Does your agent keep getting logged out?
Stuck at a code sent to your phone, or an "are you human?" check?
Does it grab your mouse and screen, and stop the moment you close your laptop?
Do you have to hand it your passwords?
And when you come back, do you even know what it did?
easi.run fixes all of it. Every agent gets its own real Chrome, on your own server, and sites see an ordinary browser.
Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client connects in one line.
Prefer Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium? Turn on CDP, attach to its port, and your scripts and skills keep working.
Close your laptop and it keeps working.
Run many at once, and never pay by the hour.
Need another country? Send each session through your own proxy, with the time zone and language to match.
Use your own Claude Code or Codex, right beside the page.
Stuck at a login, a 2FA code or a CAPTCHA? It pings you on Slack or Discord.
One click and you're driving, sharp and smooth even on a modest connection, thanks to our own streaming engine.
Drag files from your computer straight into the remote browser, copy and paste both ways, and downloads land on your computer.
You hear the page's sound live, and you can record the session with your camera and mic.
Meanwhile your agent is locked out, and what you type is hidden from it.
Hand it back, and it carries on.
Log in once, stay logged in, encrypted with your password, and lend that login to an agent without sharing it.
Missed something? A timeline and a replay show what it did.
Every browser is sandboxed, and your private network stays out of reach.
Agents scattered across tools and tabs? One dashboard runs them all: every session, agent, saved login and proxy.
It's open source and self-hosted: keep it on your own Linux machine or any server, locked with your password, 2FA and passkeys.
One prompt installs it. That's easi.run.
